subject: Geografia
description_pt: Identificar e analisar as cadeias industriais e de inovação e as consequências dos usos de recursos naturais e das diferentes fontes de energia (tais como termoelétrica, hidrelétrica, eólica e nuclear) em diferentes países.

components.description_pt: Identificar cadeias de suprimento industrial e de inovação em diferentes países
components.description_en: Identify industrial and innovation supply chains in different countries

components.description_pt: Analisar as consequências do uso de recursos naturais em diferentes fontes energéticas por país
components.description_en: Analyze the consequences of natural resource use across different energy sources in different countries
components.cc_component_description: Analyze the environmental impacts associated with human use of specific energy sources

components.description_pt: Comparar os impactos ambientais e sociais de fontes de energia termoelétrica, hidrelétrica, eólica e nuclear
components.description_en: Compare the environmental and social impacts of thermoelectric, hydroelectric, wind, and nuclear energy sources
components.cc_component_description: Identify economic, social, environmental, and geopolitical costs and risks associated with energy production or resource extraction

cc_matches.description: Energy and fuels that humans use are derived from natural sources, and their use affects the environment in multiple ways. Some resources are renewable over time, and others are not.

All forms of energy production and other resource extraction have associated economic, social, environmental, and geopolitical costs and risks as well as benefits. New technologies and social regulations can change the balance of these factors.
